name: paperloom
description: Karpathy-style LLM wiki for research papers. Ingest a URL / arXiv ID / DOI / PDF, write a structured summary into a local Obsidian vault, and maintain a finding-level knowledge graph via wikilinks + Dataview.

vault_path.title: Obsidian Vault Path
vault_path.description: Local directory for the research vault. Created by /paperloom:init if it does not exist.

open_in_obsidian.title: Open new pages in Obsidian after ingest
open_in_obsidian.description: If true, ingest opens the new paper page via the obsidian:// URI scheme.
